channel.title: WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from WBBJ 7 Eyewitness News (wbbjtv.com)

item.title: Tragic house fire occurs in Dyer County
item.description: According to Dyer County Sheriff Jeff Box, one person has died following an early morning fire in the county.

item.title: TBI: Dunlap man indicted, charged with First Degree Murder in Officer-Involved Shooting investigation
item.description: An investigation by special agents with the Tennessee Bureau of Investigation has resulted in the indictment of a Dunlap man in connection to an officer-involved shooting that occurred in December.

item.title: Trump says 8 European countries will be charged a 10% tariff for opposing US control of Greenland
item.description: President Donald Trump said Saturday that he would charge a 10% import tax starting in February on goods from eight European nations because of their opposition to American control of Greenland.

item.title: Kentucky completes another second-half comeback to stun No. 24 Tennessee, 80-78
item.description: Denzel Aberdeen scored 22 points, 18 in the second half, and Kentucky rallied from a 17-point first-half deficit to knock off No. 24 Tennessee, 80-78, on Saturday.

item.title: Local chapter of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. celebrates Founders’ Day
item.description: The Nu Gamma Zeta Chapter of Zeta Phi Beta Sorority, Inc. gathered Saturday in honor of its 106th Founders Day.

item.title: New York Giants hire John Harbaugh as coach, AP source says
item.description: The New York Giants hired John Harbaugh as coach on Saturday, a person with knowledge of the situation told The Associated Press.

item.title: Pregnant woman attacked with a baseball bat while leaving work
item.description: A pregnant woman in Wisconsin is recovering in the hospital after she was attacked with a baseball bat Thursday.

item.title: Bolivar hosts its Martin Luther King Jr. Day parade
item.description: The City of Bolivar gathered Saturday to honor the legacy of Dr. Martin Luther King, Jr. with a special event.

item.title: Elks Lodge lends support to the Jackson community
item.description: The Elks Lodge #192 provided free meals and winter supplies to the homeless Saturday.

item.title: ‘Unimaginable nightmare’: Two teen best friends die after sandpit collapses on them
item.description: Two 14-year-old best friends in Florida died after a sandpit collapsed while they were digging, according to authorities.
